subject: general
question: Which of the following countries is not a member of the World Bank Group?
solution:
The correct answer is **Cuba**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The W**orld Bank is an international financial institution **that provides loans and grants to the governments of low- and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects
 
• With **189 member countries**, staff from more than 170 countries, and offices in over 130 locations.
 
• The World Bank Group is a **unique global partnership**: five institutions working for sustainable solutions that reduce poverty and build shared prosperity in developing countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Bank is run by a president and 25 executive directors, as well as 29 various vice presidents.
 
• It has **189 and 174 member countries, respectively**.
 
• **The U.S., Japan, China, Germany, and the U.K**. have the most voting power. 
 
• The bank aims for loans to developing countries to help reduce poverty.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f00950126c6b5a2744aafc910802416add5f9c7cc228b4a8491e764d74f5f6c.png]
